unit: USD per GPU per hour, on-demand
methodology: Representative current on-demand rental price per GPU model, blended across major neoclouds and GPU marketplaces (Lambda, RunPod, Vast.ai, CoreWeave, Together, Hyperstack, TensorWave, Vultr) and the getdeploying.com / Silicon Data trackers. 'low' and 'high' are the observed marketplace range. 'currentUsdPerHr' is a blended estimate and is flagged in estimated[]. historyAnchors are real sourced price points (not a fabricated smooth series); sources vary across anchors, so the historical line is sparse and approximate. A daily recorder appends consistent points going forward so the series fills with one methodology over time. Period changes are computed from the anchor+recorded series and read '-' until enough history accrues.
